## Overview On ROCm, run the Qwen3.5 GDN `in_proj_qkvz` and `in_proj_ba` as one AITER launch (`fused_gemm_a16w16_dual_splitk`) at ≤ 64 tokens. `ba` comes back as fp32 split-K partials that the fused GDN decode sums, so there is no separate `in_proj_ba` launch and no reduce kernel. Stacked on #61428; only the last commit belongs to this PR. Off until vLLM's AITER pin includes [ROCm/aiter#7228](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/7228) (the dual GEMM) and [ROCm/aiter#7239](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/7239) (GDN decode takes `ba` partials for the fused reduce). ## Claims - in_proj → fused GDN decode, per GDN layer: **−3.4 to −5.2 µs at 16–64 tokens**, −10.0 µs at 8 tokens; +1.3 / +0.4 µs at 1–2 tokens. - Serving, against #61428: **+1.4 to +3.2 % total tok/s and −1.3 to −3.7 % mean TPOT at c16–c64**, +0.3 % / −0.5 % at c4; GSM8K unchanged. - No change on CUDA, XPU or CPU, for quantized models, LoRA or spec decode, or above 64 tokens. Before: After: ## Validation ### Op level: in_proj → GDN decode chain MI355X, Qwen3.8-27B GDN shape (N1 = 16384, N2 = 96, K = 5120, bf16 state), µs per layer: - "Stock pair" = today's ROCm dispatched pair - "Fused weight" = one GEMM on the concatenated weight - "Dual partials" = this PR | Tokens | Stock pair + GDN | Fused weight + GDN | **Dual partials + GDN** | Δ vs better other | |--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | 1 | 36.03 | **32.08** | 33.36 | +1.28 | | 2 | 36.76 | **33.36** | 33.75 | +0.39 | | 4 | 39.95 | 36.07 | **35.06** | −1.01 | | 8 | 50.09 | 45.81 | **35.78** | −10.02 | | 16 | 43.59 | 46.37 | **39.15** | −4.44 | | 32 | 51.23 | 51.87 | **47.47** | −3.76 | | 64 | 70.65 | 71.61 | **67.28** | −3.37 | ### Serving MI355X, Qwen3.8-27B BF16, TP1, `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`, 1024×1024, greedy runs. Both arms use the same image, container and AITER build; only the vLLM commit differs. | Arm | vLLM | AITER | |--|--|--| | Before | #61428 | #6884, #7228, #7239 | | After | #61428 + this PR | #6884, #7228, #7239 | | Concurrency | Total tok/s Before | After | Δ | Mean TPOT (ms) Before | After | Δ | Mean TTFT (ms) Before | After | Δ | |--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | 4 | 604.9 | 607.0 | +0.3% | 13.03 | 12.97 | −0.5% | 208.7 | 225.2 | +7.9% | | 16 | 2,005.8 | 2,050.7 | +2.2% | 15.37 | 15.02 | −2.3% | 610.5 | 614.2 | +0.6% | | 32 | 3,559.5 | 3,674.8 | +3.2% | 17.12 | 16.48 | −3.7% | 896.6 | 969.0 | +8.1% | | 64 | 6,158.7 | 6,247.6 | +1.4% | 19.50 | 19.24 | −1.3% | 1,328.2 | 1,292.8 | −2.7% | | Arm | GSM8K (5-shot, n = 1319) | |--|--:| | Before | 0.7263 | | After | 0.7263 | ### Reproduction ```bash # Server VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --kv-cache-dtype auto \ --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --async-scheduling -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True \ --language-model-only --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16 # Bench vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --endpoint /v1/completions \ --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --random-range-ratio 0.0 \ --ignore-eos --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 --num-prompts $((10 * C)) --max-concurrency $C # GSM8K lm_eval --model local-completions \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False \ --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 # Unit test pytest tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_in_proj_qkvzba.py ``` ### Tests - `tests/kernels/mamba/test_gdn_in_proj_qkvzba.py`: the custom op against a dense GEMM at 1, 64, 65 and 1000 tokens: 4/4 passes ## Details - `in_proj_qkvz` and `in_proj_ba` load into one `MergedColumnParallelLinear` `in_proj_qkvzba` (`[q, k, v, z, b, a]`). It only holds the weight; its forward is never called. - The custom op `qwen_gdn_in_proj_qkvzba` runs the dual GEMM up to 64 tokens (`skip_reduce=True`, `num_ksplit2=10`, `ba` as `[10, T, 96]` fp32 partials) and the usual two GEMMs above it. It always returns all four outputs so the fake impl has fixed shapes. - `num_ksplit2` overrides only the split count of AITER's tuned config, because it sets the partials' shape. The tuned configs give 10 at every bucket except 2–4 tokens. - The fused GDN decode sums the partials and rounds `ba` to bf16, as the GEMM would. Other paths sum them in torch. Scope: ROCm only, gated by `rocm_aiter_ops.is_fused_gdn_in_proj_dual_splitk_available()`, the flat (Qwen3.5) layout, no quantization, LoRA or spec decode. CUDA, XPU and CPU forwards are unchanged. ---

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The fused GDN input projection matches one dense GEMM on both sides of the
+dual split-K / two-GEMM token threshold."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.gdn.qwen_gdn_linear_attn import (
+    GDN_AITER_IN_PROJ_DUAL_SPLITK_AVAILABLE,
+    GDN_IN_PROJ_BA_SPLITS,
+    MAX_FUSED_IN_PROJ_QKVZBA_TOKENS,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not GDN_AITER_IN_PROJ_DUAL_SPLITK_AVAILABLE,
+    reason="needs AITER's dual split-K GEMM and fused GDN decode",
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "num_tokens",
+    [1, MAX_FUSED_IN_PROJ_QKVZBA_TOKENS, MAX_FUSED_IN_PROJ_QKVZBA_TOKENS + 1, 1000],
+)
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_in_proj_qkvzba_matches_dense_gemm(num_tokens: int) -> None:
+    hidden, qkvz_size, ba_size = 5120, 1024, 96
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    x = torch.randn(num_tokens, hidden, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    weight = (
+        torch.randn(qkvz_size + ba_size, hidden, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        * 0.05
+    )
+    qkvzba, qkvz, ba, ba_partials = torch.ops.vllm.qwen_gdn_in_proj_qkvzba(
+        x, weight, ba_size
+    )
+    assert ba_partials.shape == (GDN_IN_PROJ_BA_SPLITS, num_tokens, ba_size)
+    if num_tokens <= MAX_FUSED_IN_PROJ_QKVZBA_TOKENS:
+        qkvz, ba = qkvzba[:, :qkvz_size], ba_partials.sum(0)
+    ref = (x.float() @ weight.float().t()).to(x.dtype)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        torch.cat([qkvz, ba.to(x.dtype)], dim=-1), ref, atol=0.5, rtol=1e-2
+    )
